artifact.decision_scope: Whether to add one or more skills to complete the text-to-diagram-to-text vision

summary: Create one pilot-grade reverse reconstruction skill for textual bpmn-beta source. Defer a separate reconciliation or fidelity-gate skill until a paired conflicting-source pilot proves a distinct repeatable job.

initial_reviews.finding: The current suite is forward-oriented, but PNS and bpmn-beta contracts are not yet sufficiently stable to claim lossless interchange.
Reverse reconstruction and reconciliation are conceptually distinct, but reconciliation should wait for a real conflicting-source pilot.
Textual bpmn-beta is a portable input boundary; arbitrary image OCR must remain provisional and must not silently create authoritative process facts.

disagreement.question: Whether a second reconciliation skill is necessary immediately
disagreement.resolution: Defer the second skill and require a paired conflicting-source pilot before adding it.

required_limits: Use encoded, inferred, not-encoded, unknown, and conflict evidence statuses.
Preserve source locations and stable IDs where present.
Produce a reconstruction report and optional PNS draft, never an implicitly approved PNS.
Treat image-only observations as provisional and route ambiguity to human elicitation.
Use trace comments in visual modeling as alignment aids, not proof of completeness or approval.
release_conditions_for_expansion: Canonical PNS interchange representation is resolved.
Normal, partial/lossy, malformed, and untrusted fixtures pass deterministic checks.
A protected holdout or live evaluation demonstrates that reconciliation is a distinct repeatable release gate.
No release claim says that a bare diagram and a rich process narrative are literally lossless equivalents.
